event.desc: Al-Sakhāwī saw his handwriting from the year 826 AH on a certificate of presentation (ʿarḍ) for some who had recited to him.

person.note: アリー・ブン・アル＝ムアッラー。私は、彼に（暗誦を）提示した者の何人かに対する、ハジュラ暦826年（西暦1423年頃）の彼（アリー）の自筆（署名）を見た。
ʿAlī b. al-Muʿallā. I saw his handwriting from the year 826 AH on a certificate of presentation (ʿarḍ) for some of those who had recited to him.
